items.title: Versality characterized by the cotangent complex comparison
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file artin.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: (1) implies (2) for closed points by contradiction: an essential small extension B' -> B produced from a non-surjective H^{-1} comparison (via the constructed essential surjection) contradicts versality through Artin-Rees and a factorization argument; the H^0 injectivity is dual to surjectivity of the tangent map, which versality supplies. (2) implies (1) by lifting maps R -> C through small extensions: the obstruction ob in Ext^1(NL, I) dies because its image in Ext^1(E, I) is the obstruction of a lift that exists by (RS*).
